description.value: Just Poké is a Pacific Northwest poke bowl chain with a Richmond, BC franchise location offering dine-in, pickup, and delivery. The menu features signature bowls, build-your-own options, and sustainably-sourced sushi-grade fish. The chain emphasizes clean eating with compostable packaging and sustainably-caught ingredients.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 8m; rack at 38m; rack at 47m; rack at 54m; rack at 64m; rack at 64m; rack at 78m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Just Poké is actively open ('Open for Dine-in, Pickup & Delivery') and lists 'Richmond BC' as one of its franchise locations, validating the OSM record. The homepage and franchising page confirm pickup/takeout and dietary options (GF, Vegetarian, Vegan, Keto). No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Website copy primarily describes the chain as operating 'throughout Western Washington' with no BC-specific location page visible in the fetched content; Richmond BC appears only in the location list, so address and phone could not be independently verified against website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by website with Richmond BC listed as an active location. Offers takeout and dietary options useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Franchising page states 'Just Poke offers a variety of options to fit many dietary restrictions, including but not limited to those adhering to a Gluten Free, Vegetarian, Vegan or Keto diet.'

wow_evidence: Pacific Northwest poke bowl chain with a Richmond, BC franchise location
